name: tense_label
description: Classify temporal reference as past, present, or future; matched control identifies the grammatical subject.
generator_code:
import json,random
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
subjects=['I','you','we','they'];verbs=['walk','work','play','talk','wait','cook','jump','help'];labels=['past','present','future']
for i in range(120):
 subj=random.choice(subjects);v=random.choice(verbs);t=i%3
 sentence=[f'{subj} {v}ed yesterday.',f'{subj} {v} every day.',f'{subj} will {v} tomorrow.'][t]
 prefix=f'Sentence: "{sentence}" '
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'Is its tense past, present, or future? Answer:', 'answer':' '+labels[t]})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'What is its subject pronoun? Answer:', 'answer':' '+subj})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
